purpose: CFO-level cost-and-savings model for migrating a payment flow (payroll / remittance / merchant settlement) from card/SWIFT/ACH/SEPA to Tempo. Outputs annual savings in USD and bps, break-even months, finality improvement (days → 600ms), and a CFO memo. ISO 20022 pacs.008-subset artifact; instructed_amount, debtor, creditor, remittance_information.
